messages:
Maya (CS): Quick draft one-pager for customers: 'safety-lane' demo reserve + light prefill. Want short, copyable AM script and a tiny ops snippet. Thoughts?

Jon (SRE): Keep priming tiny by default. Suggest light: 3 prefills/10m; heavy demo reserve: 5% burst cap. Watch p99.

Priya (AM): For AM script: two lines: 1) "We warmed up a few requests so demos feel snappy." 2) "If you see noisy results we can reduce prefill or swap a smaller model."

Maya (CS): Nice. Also want a quick renewal hook: add a 'safety_lane' boolean on tenant metadata that opens a 7-day priority outreach window.

Jon (SRE): Ops snippet to paste in runbook:
```
priming:
  light_prefill: 3
  window_min: 10
  priming_ttl_min: 5
reserve:
  demo_percent: 5
  safety_ttl_days: 7
```

Priya (AM): Feedback capture: 24h micro-survey (3 checkboxes) + automatic daily sample compare. Escalate to AM if critical prompts drop >3%.

Maya (CS): I'll assemble a 1-page handout and a Slack paste for AMs. Could we add a tiny rollback recipe?

Jon (SRE): Rollback: auto-fallback to smaller model family + notify AM if p99 > 2x baseline for 2m. Add quick test: run 5 canonical prompts and check quality delta.

onboard-bot: Created doc 'safety-lane-demo-reserve' in /docs.

Priya (AM): I'll test the AM script in staging after Jon runs the priming test. :+1:

Maya (CS): Thanks all — publishing draft to #customer-success/docs tomorrow unless objections.
